scripts.postinstall: pnpm --dir frontend install && pnpm --dir e2e install
scripts.setup:api: python3 -m venv api/venv && api/venv/bin/pip install -r api/requirements.dev.txt
scripts.predev: docker compose up -d --wait db && cd api && venv/bin/python finance/manage.py migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd frontend && pnpm dev" "cd api && venv/bin/python finance/manage.py runserver"
scripts.prestart: pnpm --dir frontend build && cd api && venv/bin/python finance/manage.py migrate && venv/bin/python finance/manage.py seed_test
scripts.start: concurrently "cd frontend && pnpm start" "cd api && venv/bin/python finance/manage.py runserver"
scripts.lint:api: cd api && venv/bin/ruff check && venv/bin/ruff format --check
scripts.lint:frontend: cd frontend && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
scripts.format:api: cd api && venv/bin/ruff check --fix && venv/bin/ruff format
scripts.db:reset:e2e: export DATABASE_NAME=test && cd api && venv/bin/python finance/manage.py flush --noinput && venv/bin/python finance/manage.py seed_test
